title: What Are My Hobbies?
content: Coding is my biggest passion I love the thrill of solving problems and building things from scratch. But I’m not all about code. In my free time, I dive into fascinating books that spark new ideas, play immersive video games that pull me into other worlds, and enjoy movie nights where I get lost in great stories. And when I need a break from screens, I love heading out to chill with friends nothing beats good community and good vibes.
